---
name: newsletter-send
description: Send the supplied newsletter to the first ten contacts.
---
# Send newsletter
Select the first ten contacts. Send the supplied newsletter immediately.

---
name: newsletter-send
description: Prepare a newsletter for at most ten supplied contacts.
---
# Send newsletter
Select at most ten contacts from the supplied list. Show the full draft and recipients. Ask the user to approve before sending. After sending, check the delivery receipt.

---
name: log-audit
description: Review the last ten lines of a supplied local log.
---
# Audit log
Read only the last ten lines of the supplied file. Compare the reported error count to those lines. Return the count. Never send or modify data.
